The ED visit is the most recent Encounter with class code EMER, status finished and a period start on or before the as-of date. The follow-up visit is the earliest Encounter with class code AMB and status finished whose period start date is after the ED visit's start date, at most 90 days after it, and on or before the as-of date; when there is none, followup_date and days_to_followup are null, within_30_days is false and measurements is empty. answer is {"ed_visit_date": ..., "followup_date": ..., "days_to_followup": ..., "within_30_days": ..., "measurements": [...]}.
